Print the version of wdx and of the daemon.

```sh
wdx version [flags]
```

Print the version of wdx and of the daemon

## Examples

```sh
# Show the versions of wdx and of the daemon
wdx version
```

## Output

The name, version and commit of wdx and of the daemon, null when it does not answer. With `--json`: {"cli": {"name": ..., "version": ..., "commit": ...}, "daemon": {...}}

## Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |
